title: Fixed configurations at stop states
statement: Let $K$ be a natural number, let $Q,T,P_t,P_s$ be types, and let $R_t,R_s$ be Turing machines with respectively one and $K+1$ work tapes over record symbols. Choose test states $t_e,t_y,t_n$ and step states $s_e,s_y,s_n$. For any input and configuration $d$ of the loop machine, any exit label $e$, and any natural number $t$, if $d$ is in stop state $e$, then after $t$ steps the loop machine is still at exactly $d$.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ is a natural number; $Q,T,P_t,P_s$ are types
$R_t$ and $R_s$ have the specified tape counts and record-symbol alphabet
The six test and step states are given
An input list and configuration $d$ of the loop machine are given
An exit label $e$ and time $t\in\mathbb N$ are given
